title: My Family's Mansion
content: I've made posts before about my reoccurring mansion worlds, but I don't think I've ever talked about my "Family's Mansion". I visited the mansion last night which sparked the thought. To be clear, my family has never lived in a mansion (or anything close to one). So in the dreams, I'm always trying to convince myself that it's real.. trying to come up with some sort of story in my head as to HOW my family moved into this huge mansion with the little money we have. In present time, my family consists of my parents, my younger twin brothers (27) and myself (32F)- I've been moved out of my parents house since I was 18 and both of my brothers moved out a few years ago too. So it always feels a bit awkward living back at home in these dreams. IRL, my one brother is married.. my other brother is in a serious relationship of 5 years and I've been with my boyfriend for 4 years but no significant others live with us at the mansion. I even find myself having strange feelings from when I was younger about having my boyfriend over, I'm always plotting how to 'sneak him in'. Last night my dream was even stranger because even though the mansion was sprawling with bedrooms, I was forced to share a bedroom with my 1 brother. My other brother got his own huge bedroom with an attached full bathroom and a private game room. I was so jealous and trying to convince him how unfair it was that I had to share a room with his twin.. and I'm the oldest! For whatever reason, my whole family agreed HE was deserving of his own room (basically his own WING of the house). The mansion is 3 stories. The 3rd story is just as spacious as the other 2 floors. I'm always obsessed with how wide the staircases are. They have beautiful carpeting that's super plush and comfy on my feet. The home doesn't have many furnishings, it's as if we JUST moved in and are starting fresh. I enjoy running through the house exploring, of course I'm always in awe and trying to figure out how this is all OURS. I want to invite people over, I want to show off the home. But then again, I'm intruded with thoughts of... "do our parents even want us living here? We're all old and were moved out.. and now we're back? What's everyone going to think about us all living back at home now?" etc. &#x200B;
